text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, quetiapine fumarate is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 45 tablets (5.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 204.11 units (24.4 days on hand). Both sites stock Aurobindo Pharma Limited product NDC 65862049101, registered plant FEI 3004021229.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 684552 for FEI 3004021229 ended 2010-09-24 and was classified OAI with a known date of 2010-12-23. Subsequent inspections 750125, 940768, 1010385, 1061698, 1090627, 1155879, and 1210950 were all classified VAI, the most recent ending 2023-07-21.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General inventory supports a transfer while maintaining adequate supply. Alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list; however, three of four alternative labels do not identify a manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 65 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Place a purchase order with NorthStar Rx LLC — requires buyer approval; product sourced from Aurobindo Pharma Limited (last inspection VAI 2023-07-21).
3. Evaluate Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc., A-S Medication Solutions, and ACI Healthcare USA, Inc. only if plant information becomes available — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
